scripts.dev:web: node scripts/run-profile.mjs sandbox web pnpm exec next dev -p 3000
scripts.dev:api: node scripts/run-profile.mjs sandbox api pnpm exec next dev -p 3001
scripts.worker:check: node scripts/run-profile.mjs sandbox worker pnpm exec tsx src/index.ts --check
scripts.test: pnpm docs:check && pnpm db:test && pnpm -r test
scripts.worker:sandbox: node scripts/run-profile.mjs sandbox worker pnpm exec tsx src/index.ts --run
scripts.worker:production: node scripts/run-profile.mjs production worker pnpm exec tsx src/index.ts --run
scripts.worker:playground: node scripts/run-profile.mjs sandbox worker pnpm exec tsx src/index.ts --playground
scripts.voice:sandbox: node scripts/run-profile.mjs sandbox voice pnpm exec tsx src/index.ts
scripts.build:production: node scripts/run-profile.mjs production api pnpm build && node scripts/run-profile.mjs production web pnpm build
